question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**credible**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains Aristotle’s tools of persuasion—ethos, pathos, and logos.
 
• Ethos refers to the speaker’s credibility or trustworthiness.
 
• Thus, the word that best completes the blank is "**credible**".
 
• Other options such as "unreliable", "misleading", and "confusing" express negative qualities and do not fit the meaning of ethos.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unreliable:** opposite of trustworthy; does not fit the idea of ethos.
 
• **Misleading: **incorrect because ethos requires honesty and trust.
 
• **Confusing: **unrelated to credibility or character.
